visualHandoffContract.inputBoundary: Unknown input is descriptor-snapshotted once, strictly key-checked, range-checked, copied, and frozen. Accessors, symbols, non-enumerable extensions, hostile proxies, URL-like fields, and edge/schema drift fail closed.
visualHandoffContract.transportBoundary: Only the sanitized runtime handoff reaches snapshots, reset context, inert marker, and allowlisted CSS variables. Handoff is not written to sessionStorage or history state; source recovery atomically changes to direct + null.

returnStateContract.refreshContinuation: A validated stored revision 20 initializes the next semantic write at revision 21.
returnStateContract.malformedHighRevision: A malformed or out-of-range stored revision is not a stale-write authority; the next valid write starts at revision 1.

saturation.trigger: A validated stored revision of 999999999 plans revision 1 with resetStorage=true.
saturation.storageBoundary: removeItem, getItem, and setItem are guarded. A failed operation returns unavailable and cannot trap the coordinator.
saturation.epochRule: Before a saturation reset write, the pending media timer is cleared and the per-path epoch increments. A pre-reset 2000ms callback carries the old epoch/revision receipt and cannot overwrite revision 1.
saturation.browserResult: After waiting beyond the old throttle, persisted revision remained 1.

pagehide.result: With stored revision 10, a pending timeupdate at 3s, and pagehide after setting 7s, the synchronous final write persisted revision 11 and time >= 6.5s.
pagehide.staleTimerResult: After 2200ms the earlier throttled callback did not overwrite the pagehide write; reload restored the same tail time paused.

returnStateContract.storageAndUrlContainment: The codec restores media only by manifest-allowlisted media id. A URL-shaped active media id is rejected and no video URL is accepted from storage, history, or handoff payload data.

multiMediaRecovery.result: Refresh and history preserve both completed ids, the independent skipped id, and the distinct active id. Audible playing is never restored: the video is paused and muted.
replayRules: completed -> Replay clears the replayed completed outcome while active
skipped -> Replay clears the replayed skipped outcome while active
Replay refresh remains encodable because active media is disjoint from both outcome sets
Replay ended writes the latest completed outcome and removes skipped
Replay skip writes the latest skipped outcome and removes completed
gateReleased remains sticky through Replay and its next outcome

narrativeController.matrixProof: All 9 phases x 15 public event kinds are evaluated. Rejected events preserve the identical state object. Generation-bearing play and ended continuations, and segment-bearing settled continuations, reject stale or mismatched receipts.
narrativeController.stickyRelease: released-hold always has gateReleased=true; inertia plus a distinct fresh forward input advances, while reverse-to-tail restores the completed segment rather than reopening its gate.

raceResults: A stale fulfill/reject/playing/ended continuation cannot write reducer state or outcomes.
A stale attempt does not pause a replacement that owns the same element.
A replacement generation is recorded by controller and reducer before its play Promise settles.
Lifecycle UI actions use the reducer phase matrix and fail closed before controller invalidation.
navigation, hidden, pagehide, and unmount remain unconditional ownership invalidations.
